description: W.R. Arthur v Mallika Gunathilaka, W.R. Arthur v Mallika Gunathilaka, View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: W.R. Arthur v Mallika Gunathilaka, W.R. Arthur v Mallika Gunathilaka, View More
keywords: The Plaintiff instituted a vindicatory action in the District Court of Homagama seeking a declaration of title, while the Defendant claimed prescriptive title as an ande cultivator in possession for over 15 years. Held — in vindicatory actions the sole burden lies on the plaintiff to establish ownership and possession by the defendant on a balance of probability; the defendant\'s documents were unsupportive of his prescriptive claim; trial judge correctly evaluated witness credibility; appeal dismissed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
